import schema from '@omne-harness-lite/content-blocks/schema' with { type: 'json' };
import { Ajv2020 } from 'ajv/dist/2020.js';
import { copyJsonValue, isNonNegativeJsonInteger, LosslessNumber } from "./json.js";
export const schemaId = schema.$id;
export const SCHEMA_DEF_NAMES = [
    'ContentBlock',
    'BlockBase',
    'TextBlock',
    'ThinkingBlock',
    'VoiceBlock',
    'ImageBlock',
    'FileBlock',
    'ToolCallBlock',
    'IncompleteToolCallBlock',
    'ToolResultBlock',
    'Visibility',
    'DerivedRendering',
    'AttachmentRef',
    'InlineBytes',
    'MediaType',
    'Modality',
    'ExecutionOutcome',
    'PlaceholderReason',
    'BlockId',
    'CallId',
    'CapabilityId',
    'ModelToolName',
];
// Fixed owned Schema only; no caller schemas or mutable root validation cache.
const ajv = new Ajv2020({
    strict: true,
    strictTypes: false,
    strictRequired: false,
    allErrors: false,
    ownProperties: true,
});
ajv.addSchema({ ...schema, $id: schemaId });
const validators = Object.freeze(SCHEMA_DEF_NAMES.map(name => {
    const validator = ajv.getSchema(`${schemaId}#/$defs/${name}`);
    if (validator === undefined)
        throw new Error(`missing Schema definition: ${name}`);
    return Object.freeze({ name, validator });
}));
/** Schema only; cross-member constraints and rejection precedence belong to judgeContentBlock. */
export function validate(defName, value) {
    const copied = copyJsonValue(value);
    if ('failed' in copied)
        return Object.freeze({ valid: false });
    const projected = schemaProjection(copied.ok);
    const entry = validators.find(item => item.name === defName);
    if (entry === undefined)
        throw new Error(`unknown Schema definition: ${defName}`);
    const valid = entry.validator(projected) === true && exactBytes(defName, copied.ok);
    return Object.freeze({ valid });
}
function schemaProjection(value) {
    // The only Schema-constrained numeric member is AttachmentRef.bytes (integer >= 0).
    // Its original number is checked exactly below. This view changes no caller data.
    if (LosslessNumber.is(value))
        return 0;
    if (Array.isArray(value))
        return value.map(schemaProjection);
    if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
        return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, schemaProjection(item)]));
    }
    return value;
}
function exactBytes(defName, value) {
    if (defName === 'AttachmentRef')
        return attachmentBytes(value);
    if (defName === 'DerivedRendering') {
        return (isObject(value) &&
            (!Array.isArray(value.blocks) || value.blocks.every(item => exactBytes('ContentBlock', item))));
    }
    if ([
        'ContentBlock',
        'BlockBase',
        'TextBlock',
        'ThinkingBlock',
        'VoiceBlock',
        'ImageBlock',
        'FileBlock',
        'ToolCallBlock',
        'IncompleteToolCallBlock',
        'ToolResultBlock',
    ].includes(defName)) {
        if (!isObject(value))
            return true;
        if ((value.kind === 'voice' || value.kind === 'image') && !attachmentBytes(value.data))
            return false;
        if (value.kind === 'file' && !attachmentBytes(value.attachment))
            return false;
        if (value.kind === 'tool_result') {
            if (!attachmentBytes(value.offloaded))
                return false;
            if (Array.isArray(value.blocks) &&
                !value.blocks.every(item => exactBytes('ContentBlock', item)))
                return false;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(value.renderings) &&
            !value.renderings.every(item => exactBytes('DerivedRendering', item)))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}
function attachmentBytes(value) {
    return !isObject(value) || !Object.hasOwn(value, 'bytes') || isNonNegativeJsonInteger(value.bytes);
}
export function isObject(value) {
    return (value !== null &&
        typeof value === 'object' &&
        !Array.isArray(value) &&
        !LosslessNumber.is(value));
}
